title_zh: 为宗教展签确定观点归属写法

scenario.label_zh: 为宗教展签明确观点归属
scenario.goal_zh: 区分展品所表达的信仰与展馆断言，并确定加上归属说明

context_zh: 博物馆编辑与研究人员核对虚构宗教展区的一幅绘画说明。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: The label says this painting shows divine judgement. Are we stating that as our own belief?

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: We are describing the artist's religious tradition, but the wording should make that clear.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: The next sentence presents eternal life as a fact. That has the same problem.

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: Yes. It is a doctrine of the community that commissioned the painting, not a claim the museum is asking visitors to accept.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: How about starting with, "In the beliefs of the community that commissioned this work"?

sentences.speaker: Joel
sentences.text: That works. Then we can explain what the figures represent within that tradition.

sentences.speaker: Amina
sentences.text: I will add that phrase and keep the rest clearly attributed to the community.
